title: tabs-unify — the unified SegmentedTabs (segmented · pill · underline, one elastic indicator)
headline: Collapse the five-artefact tabs surface (BouncyToggle/BouncyTabs/UnderlineTabs/useBouncySlider + the standalone ResponsiveTabs) onto ONE component — SegmentedTabs — with a three-value variant axis and ONE shared elastic indicator gliding on --spring-snappy AND squishing on travel (volume-preserving, capped LOW). Clean break, no alias.

liveArmNotes: ORCHESTRATOR π LIVE TUNING (chrome-devtools-mcp @ localhost:5173 /navigation/tabs): (1) GLIDE — click between two far segments on the DEFAULT segmented strip; the .segmented-indicator must MOVE smoothly (getBoundingClientRect().left deviates) on --spring-snappy, NOT crossfade. (2) SQUISH — getComputedStyle(indicator).getPropertyValue('--stretch') must EXCEED 1 mid-travel (peak ~1.08 on a full-width jump, ~1.0x on a neighbour hop) then RELEASE to 1; the indicator visibly widens then settles to fit (Material 'grow then shrink'). The cap token is --tab-indicator-max-stretch:1.08 — TUNE between 1.06-1.10 if the squish reads too strong/weak (iOS-26.2 is restrained; lower is safer). (3) PRESS — press-and-hold a segment: animatePress is ONE settle-into squish to --scale-press-btn (0.97) on --spring-snappy, NO ring-past-1 (the old --spring-bouncy 1.08 overshoot is GONE). (4) VARIANTS — confirm pill (solid --foreground pill) + underline (role=tablist hairline rule) both glide+squish; underline ::before reads scale: var(--stretch) 1 (X-only width flex). (5) ARIA — underline emits role=tablist/tab+aria-selected; segmented/pill emit role=group+aria-pressed (axe-clean). (6) RESPONSIVE — narrow viewport <640px on the responsive section: the strip collapses to a <Select>; widen restores the strip; one v-model drives both. (7) MULTI-SELECT — the multi-select section flips N segments independently (no glide between, each pops). Magnitudes: --tab-indicator-max-stretch:1.08, --spring-snappy (control register), --scale-press-btn:0.97, --duration-normal glide clock, 60ms squish-release timer in useTabIndicator.
